pattern.description: Continuous camera push-in (about 1.75x) onto the progress checklist while successive tasks get their checkbox filled green and a strike line drawn through the greyed label, leaving only the last task open.
pattern.why_premium: The push-in and the completion cascade build together, so scale and rhythm both escalate toward the final unchecked item; the zoom makes small UI ticks legible and satisfying.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.checklist', {scale: 1}, {scale: 1.75, transformOrigin: '20% 60%', duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); in parallel per row: tl.to('.row .box', {backgroundColor: '#6f8a5a', scale: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: 'back.out(2)', stagger: 0.2}, 0) and tl.fromTo('.row .strike', {scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: 'left'}, {scaleX: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'none', stagger: 0.2}, 0) with label colour to grey.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 22], [1, 1.75], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); per row i: strike = interpolate(frame - i*5, [0, 6], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); checkbox pop = spring({frame: frame - i*5, fps, config: {damping: 12, stiffness: 220}}).

notes: Continuation of e002's checklist cascade in the same shot. SFX pulses are evenly spaced, so they may be music rather than UI ticks; needs a listen.
